# weka_user (Resource)

A user that can authenticate to the cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "weka_user" "s3" {
  username  = "s3user"
  password  = "ChangeMe-1"
  role      = "S3"
  posix_uid = 1000
  posix_gid = 1000
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for the user. The API never returns it, so the configured value stays in state and a read that omits it is not a change. Changing it sets the password; other updates do not.
- `username` (String) User name. Changing it replaces the user.

### Optional

- `posix_gid` (Number) POSIX GID for this user's S3 files. Server default on create; removing this later keeps the current value rather than reverting, since the API has no way to ask for the default back. Stored as a float32, exact only up to 2^24.
- `posix_uid` (Number) POSIX UID for this user's S3 files. Server default on create; removing this later keeps the current value rather than reverting, since the API has no way to ask for the default back. Stored as a float32, exact only up to 2^24.
- `role` (String) Role of the user (ClusterAdmin, OrgAdmin, ReadOnly, Regular, S3, or CSI). Server default on create; removing this later keeps the current value rather than reverting, since the API has no way to ask for the default back.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) User UID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by username or UID.
terraform import weka_user.s3 s3user
```
